summary_en: 43,000,000 shares (4.86% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired up to ¥30,000M via open-market purchase June 17–Dec 30, 2026. All acquired shares to be cancelled Jan 29, 2027. Rationale: fulfil 80%+ cumulative payout ratio target over FY3/24–FY3/28 period announced Oct 31, 2023.
title_en: Notice regarding decision on acquisition of treasury shares and cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On June 16, 2026, ZOZO's board approved a treasury share acquisition program under Article 459 of the Companies Act and the company's bylaws, along with cancellation under Article 178. The company will acquire up to 43,000,000 ordinary shares (4.86% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥30,000M via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between June 17 and December 30, 2026. All acquired shares will be cancelled on January 29, 2027. The acquisition is undertaken to support the company's October 31, 2023 capital allocation policy targeting a cumulative payout ratio (including buybacks) exceeding 80% over the five-year period from FY3/24 to FY3/28. Funding will derive from on-hand liquidity and, if needed, borrowings; the company expects to maintain adequate working capital and financial soundness following the acquisition.
